training_eligibility: Require complete2880 decisions, no early stop, zero nonfoot contact, support>=.90, COMmin>=1.20, original slip<=.5, sensed six-leg cycle completion and correct sign actual yaw abs>=.001. Full speed also requires original forward>=.05; half speed reports original forward failure separately and requires achieved forward>=.025. No claim that original all5 passed if speed gate fails.
if_ineligible: Do not train on rejected teacher data as successful demonstration. Diagnose/refine teacher in new preregistered amendment; preserve all initial failures.
commands: [speed_scale-1,yaw_rate/.008], actual smooth-ramped teacher commands; zero during original actual960decision prefix
targets: Actual teacher42 normalized incremental rates; no phase/time/role to actor. Original baseline actual2880 observation/output trajectory used as neutral-command retention target.
learning: Stage1 100 full-contiguous sequence Adam updates only new command_encoder, lr.003. Stage2 fixed400 updates base actor lr.0001 and adapter lr.001. Clip total gradient norm1.0. Each update sees admitted teacher episodes and neutral retention episode, each episode weighted equally; teacher warmup receives retention target from exact parent hidden sequence instead of forcing parent to refit teacher prime.
checkpoint_policy: save100/200/300/400/500 with model+optimizer+RNG+complete curve and sources; actual physical evaluate only100/500; earliest preregistered eligible candidate selected, not minimum scalar loss
selection: Straight neutral new actual physical rollout must preserve original all5 gates and all6 sensed cycles; actual mirrored full-speed turn must preserve same gates/all6cycles with correct yaw signs and abs(yaw)>=.01rad. Half-speed requires predeclared support/nonfoot/COM/slip plus signedforward>=.025 and all6cycles; original forward gate still reported unchanged. First diagnostics use1ms endpoint engineering checks, full native audit required before final acceptance.
validation: Separate physical motor pulse initial conditions collected only after fixed teacher eligibility; no fabricated independent validation by slicing training episode. Initial fit/retention loss are training diagnostics, not heldout validation. Source/identity/checkpoint exactness verified before deployment. Every candidate's physical safety and command response must be tested independently.
limits: This does not preregister odor behavior PPO settings; those require measured motor range and new fixed layout plan before training. No genuine ingestion, satiety or original connectome claim. No change to baseline XML/PD/force/gates. Refine plans only through new declared amendments, never retroactive pass labels.
